claims.text: Section 7.2 says either party may terminate, but only on the listed grounds. The only mutual ground is written agreement of both parties, so there is no unilateral termination for convenience.

citations.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement without penalty and without prejudice to any claims arising prior to termination as follows:
(a) Upon the written agreement of both parties.

claims.text: Termination for the other party's breach is available to either party only after written notice specifying the breach and a cure period has passed. The cure period is five business days for NPC's failure to provide required funds to pay Merchants, and thirty business days for any other breach.

citations.quote: provided          the terminating party has given written notice of the breach to the          other party specifying the breach, the action necessary to cure the          breach and the breaching party has not cured the breach within five          business days after notice is given of any failure by NPC to provide          any funds required hereunder to be provided by NPC to pay Merchants or          within thirty business days after notice is given of any other breach.

claims.text: Section 6.2 gives either party a right to terminate on prior written notice if NPC does not request Compliance Modifications, or the parties cannot agree on their terms. This right is tied to a compliance trigger, not to convenience.

citations.quote: If NPC does not request any Compliance Modifications or the parties cannot agree upon the terms of any Compliance Modifications, then either party may terminate this Agreement upon prior written notice to the other party

claims.text: The term runs five years and then renews automatically for one-year terms unless a party gives written notice of non-renewal at least six months before renewal. This governs expiry and renewal, not early termination.

citations.quote: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless one party gives the other party written notice of non-renewal at least six months prior to automatic renewal.

claims.text: Some termination rights are one-sided. NCB may terminate upon NPC's bankruptcy filing, and NPC may terminate immediately if NCB's Visa/MasterCard agreements or membership are terminated or materially limited in a way that impairs NPC's processing ability.

citations.quote: By NCB immediately upon NPC's voluntary filing of any          petition or complaint seeking relief under any federal or state          bankruptcy or other debt relief statute

(d) By NPC immediately in the event that any agreements          between NCB and Visa and/or MasterCard or NCB's membership in either          such bankcard association shall be terminated or materially limited
